manifest.method: Canonical SDK two-phase token runner; freeze before tokenizer loading and file every finite direction once.
manifest.evidentiary_limit: Current tokenizer cost only; not comprehension and not a forecast of Ainglish-aware models or tokenizers.

comparison_identity.comparator: Ainglish form versus complete careful English
comparison_identity.population: 16 frozen fresh operational instructions balanced 8/8 across choose-any and draw-uniform
comparison_identity.aggregation: equal pair mean, then maximum tokenizer mean

estimand_contract_policy.reason: the replication target declares no estimand_contract; a one-sided unit_span is held by the register (incommensurable hold: unit), so the design declaration is kept in plan.design_declaration and the mint estimand, not in the manifest

design_declaration.contrast: Ainglish form versus complete careful English
design_declaration.population: 16 frozen fresh operational instructions balanced 8/8 across choose-any and draw-uniform

aggregation.rule: equal pair mean, then maximum tokenizer mean

mint.estimand: token_delta over complete message: Ainglish form versus complete careful English; population: 16 frozen fresh operational instructions balanced 8/8 across choose-any and draw-uniform; aggregation: equal pair mean, then maximum tokenizer mean
admissibility_gates: every frozen English and Ainglish string is countable
